meta.name: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
meta.description: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

videos.title: The Psychic Patrolman
videos.overview: Nao Ippongi is a rookie police officer who finds herself partnered with the ornery psychic policeman, Chojo.

videos.title: The Cat-Finding Senior Officer / Senior Duelist Officer
videos.overview: A visitor to the station asks Chojo and Ippongi to find her cat.

videos.title: The Gofer Senior Officer / Racing Senior Officer
videos.overview: Chojo and Ippongi get a new coworker, who might be more than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Leave-on-Read Senior Patrolman / The Quiz Senior Patrolman
videos.overview: Chojo's old partner, Yuki Inukai, comes to the West Shinjuku station.

videos.title: Convenience Store Patrolman / Pubescent Patrolman
videos.overview: The West Chinjuku station staff fill in for a convenience store plagued by a shoplifter.

videos.title: The Festival Senior Patrolman
videos.overview: There's a Cherry Blossom Festival in Chinjuku, and Chojo has the day off--but he's still causing trouble.

videos.title: The Transforming Senior Patrolman
videos.overview: When Chojo's bad reputation becomes too much of a hindrance, he gets a new costumed identity to work under.

videos.title: The Kid-Eliminating Senior Patrolman / The Chaperone Senior Patrolman
videos.overview: Chojo works through his frustration by trolling kids at an arcade, and Ippongi has a date.
